info.name: Event Manager - Events & Guest List
info.description: Event & Guest List service: lifecycle and status rules, guest list limits and duplicates, invitations (resend limit, revoke), companion approvals, staff accounts and assignments. Covers valid, invalid, wrong-role and other-owner requests.

exec: pm.test('link found in dev outbox', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(j.items[0].token).to.be.a('string'); pm.collectionVariables.set('staff_a_setup_token', j.items[0].token); });
